author: Alex Kahn
description: In-house B2B enrichment — MX/SMTP/catch-all email verification, decision-maker email finding, and keyless public-profile enrichment (avatars, logos, social handles), so you don't pay PDL/Apollo/Clearbit per lookup.
name: @absolutejs/enrich

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target=bun && bun build src/profile.ts --outdir dist --target=browser && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json
